title: EvaluationMetricFile
description: Schema for a single hot-loadable evaluation metric file under ./metrics/<metric_code>.metric.json

metric_code.description: Stable machine identifier; must match the file basename (excluding .metric.json).

parent_dimension.description: Roll-up target. The 5 fixed parent dimensions are preserved for red-line and overall scoring compatibility.

applicable_roles.description: Roles this metric applies to. Use '*' to mean role-agnostic.

applicable_scenarios.description: Scenario tags this metric applies to. Use '*' to match any scenario.

evidence_signals.description: Hints about what runtime data segments contain evidence for this metric.

include.description: Whitelist of runtime data paths to include in the per-metric prompt slice.

aggregation_strategy.description: How per-scenario scores collapse into a single per-metric score.

red_line.description: Optional. If a metric carries a red-line trigger, declare it here so the deterministic redLineCheck step can find it.

industry.description: Optional. Industries this metric applies to. The wildcard '*' means match-all. Consumed by STEP 1.2 curation as an add/remove signal. Defaults to empty (no industry signal) when omitted.

responsibility_tags.description: Optional. Responsibility tags from the same vocabulary as role-catalog-entry.responsibility_tags. Consumed by STEP 1.2 curation. Defaults to empty when omitted.

complementary_metrics.description: Optional. metric_codes recommended together with this metric. STEP 1.2 MAY use this to add a complement when this metric is selected. Defaults to empty when omitted.

exclusive_with.description: Optional. metric_codes that conflict with this metric and should not co-occur in the same selected_metrics set. MUST be disjoint from complementary_metrics and MUST NOT contain this metric's own metric_code (enforced by reviewers / STEP 1.2, not by JSON Schema alone). Defaults to empty when omitted.
